performance.verdict: Paid ads fully dark 28 days; 5 overdue SOW milestones block renewal decision.

findings.text: Renewal closed 7/23 but scoreboard still untrusted: 0 paid leads, 0 appointments in GHL, 0 attributable new patients confirmed across 28 days.
Phone-match attribution gap (due 8/7), sync/contact cleanup (due 8/14), and dashboard (due 8/31) all overdue — renewal walk-or-stay decision cannot be made without these.
Spend efficiency is unmeasurable: $0 spend across all 28 days on Meta and Google Ads; CPL is undefined with 0 leads generated.
GBP actions dropped to 0 for the last 7 days (prior 7d: ~58 actions); SC clicks fell -18.75% — organic presence is weakening with no paid floor beneath it.

GA4 sessions rose 26.98% 7d vs prior 7d (recent 3-day avg ~7.7 vs prior 3-day avg ~12.7 — fading); 109 GHL opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments, confirming intake pipeline is not converting.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 5 overdue SOW milestones immediately; dashboard and attribution gap are renewal blockers by 2026-09-15.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones are past due: renewal decision (7/23), phone-match attribution (8/7), sync cleanup (8/14), and dashboard live (8/31) — all undelivered. The client's stay-or-walk decision requires a trusted scoreboard showing leads → scheduled → showed → new patient, and that dashboard does not exist yet. Success check: all 5 items marked complete in Monday with client confirmation by 2026-09-15. Nacer (Ops) owns delivery; Sohib (Account) owns client communication.

suggestions.text: Diagnose why Meta and Google Ads have been at $0 spend for 28 days; confirm whether campaigns are paused by client or Flow.
suggestions.monday_update: All paid channels show $0 spend across the full 28-day window with 0 leads generated — campaigns appear fully paused on both Meta and Google Ads. Before any budget or creative decision can be made, the account team must confirm with Dr. Jamal/Lily whether this pause was client-directed or an unintended lapse, and document the answer. Success check: pause reason confirmed in writing and campaign status (stay paused or reactivate) decided by 2026-09-10. Per the 7/19 call architecture, reactivation should prioritize Google/LSA.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions: 0 for 7 consecutive days after averaging ~8/day prior; re-check 2026-09-14.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell to 0 for the last 7 days after averaging roughly 8 actions per day in the prior period (201 total over 28 days). With paid ads dark, GBP is the only active lead-facing channel, making this drop significant. No action is taken this cycle because the cause is unconfirmed — could be a GBP data reporting lag or a genuine drop in local visibility. Re-check on 2026-09-14: if actions remain at 0 for a second consecutive 7-day window, escalate as a confirmed organic visibility issue.
